newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Bilfinger wins 380 mln dmk contracts.
newsitem.headline: German Bilfinger wins 380 mln dmk contracts.

text.p: German builder Bilfinger + Berger said on Tuesday it had won foreign construction contracts totalling 380 million marks ($220 million).

In a statement the group said that it would participate in expanding Thailand's Second Stage Expressway in Bangkok, building an 8.5 kilometer-long stretch of highway including on and off ramps as well as widening a six kilometre stretch.
The contract, for which work began in April and is scheduled to be completed in 2000, is valued at 230 million marks.
Bilfinger also won two separate contracts in Nigeria valued at 80 million and 70 million marks each.
For the 80 million mark contract Bilfinger will help refurbish a 560 kilometer stretch of road and for the 70 million mark contract it will participate in laying a pipeline.
